intro: To turn off chat history in ChatGPT on Mac, click your name at the bottom left, choose Settings, then open Data Controls. There, turn off a Chat history & training switch if your version shows one, or select Delete All Chats, which clears the sidebar but only the running history inside the app.
tldr: The Mac app may not show a single switch to turn off chat history. Start in Settings > Data Controls and read the labels.
Delete All Chats clears the sidebar. iDownloadBlog says it removes only the running history in the app.
For a chat you do not want kept, press ⌘⇧N to start a temporary chat.
A September 2026 bug can leave deleted chats in Recents. OpenAI closed the report without a confirmed fix.

blocks.text: Where the history settings live on the Mac app

Chat history controls sit in Settings, under Data Controls. You reach Settings by clicking your name at the bottom left of the ChatGPT window and choosing Settings. If you prefer the keyboard, press ⌘, instead. OpenAI's Commands reference lists ⌘, for opening settings, so it should work from the main window. Both the April 2024 OS X Daily walkthrough and the July 2025 iDownloadBlog steps send you to Data Controls next. That is the screen to check first.

Data Controls is a single screen with a few choices on it. Some guides show a switch for chat history and model training. Others show only a delete option. Menus can change between builds, so read the labels on your screen rather than trusting a screenshot from an old article.

items: Your name, bottom left: opens the account area where Settings lives.
Settings: opens the preferences window. Press ⌘, to open it from the keyboard.
Data Controls: holds the history, training and deletion options.
Delete All Chats: clears the sidebar after you click Confirm.

blocks.text: Turn off Chat history & training if you can find it

OS X Daily's April 2024 guide tells you to open Settings, choose Data Controls, then toggle off Chat history & training. It describes the setting as applying to ChatGPT use in OpenAI's apps and on the website. If your app still shows that switch, it is the cleanest answer to this question.

The catch is that the newer Mac guide does not mention it. iDownloadBlog's July 2025 steps stop at Delete All Chats. A 2024 thread in the OpenAI Developer Community also reports the option missing from web settings. The poster said the FAQ was later updated to match the new interface, on May 13, 2024. The layout has changed before, so the old guides may point to the wrong place.
Check your own screen. If you see the switch, turn it off. If you do not, the Mac app may not offer it, and the options below are what you have to work with.
What Delete All Chats really removes

Delete All Chats is the one history step that both Mac guides confirm. Select it, then click Confirm in the pop-up. The sidebar should empty. For most people, that is what turning off history means in practice.

Here is the catch. iDownloadBlog says deleting from the app only removes a running history of your chats from the app itself. It also says your conversations were uploaded to OpenAI's servers, and that ChatGPT may still reference past chats. An empty sidebar tells you what the app shows. It does not tell you what OpenAI keeps.

OS X Daily also quoted an older OpenAI FAQ. It said unsaved chats will be deleted from OpenAI's systems within 30 days. That quote dates from 2024. OpenAI's current Data Controls help pages could not be opened during research, so treat the 30-day figure as an old claim, not a current promise.
A worked example: clearing one work chat

Say you used ChatGPT last week to draft a client email, and you want that one chat gone from the sidebar. Deleting a single chat and deleting all chats are different actions. For the single chat, follow the separate steps in [how to delete a chat in ChatGPT on Mac](/how-to/delete-a-chat-in-chatgpt). Use Delete All Chats only when you want the whole list cleared.

The draft itself deserves the same caution. If the text holds client names, figures or contract terms, remove them before you paste it into any chat. A cleared sidebar does not change what was already uploaded, so the safest move is to keep sensitive text out of the chat in the first place.
Use Temporary Chat for one conversation at a time

A 2024 OpenAI developer thread offers Temporary Chat as the workaround when the chat history option is missing. On the web, the toggle sits in the model selector at the top left of the chat window. On the Mac app, the fastest route is the keyboard. Press ⌘⇧N to start a new temporary chat.

OpenAI's Commands reference lists ⌘⇧N for a new temporary chat, and marks it ChatGPT only. Quick Chat is a different action, listed as ⌘⌥N in the same reference. Use temporary chats for one-off questions. Use a normal chat when you want to return to the thread later.

Mistakes people make when they turn off chat history

items: Assuming Delete All Chats erases everything. It clears the sidebar and the running history in the app.
Hunting for a switch that is not on your screen. Read the labels in Data Controls, then use Temporary Chat.
Using Quick Chat for private work without testing it. The sources do not say whether its chats stay out of history.
Trusting a 2024 screenshot. The layout has changed since the older guides were written.
Forgetting that the sidebar can lag. Deleted chats can stay in Recents, so check after you delete.
Believing ChatGPT forgets a chat because it left the sidebar. ChatGPT may still reference past chats.

blocks.text: The Recents bug after deleting chats

Since September 2026, some Mac users report that deleted chats stay in the Recents sidebar. The bug thread opened on September 8, 2026. Users reported errors such as Could not load this ChatGPT conversation and Failed to delete conversation. Signing out, quitting and clearing the com.openai.chat cache did not remove the stale entries.

OpenAI said a fix was deployed on September 18, 2026. On September 26, it said the problem was not fully resolved, and it closed the thread without a confirmed fix. Reported workarounds include Quick Chat, deleting the parent project, or a full local data wipe. The wipe is the drastic one, so copy out anything you need first and try the simpler steps before you reach for it.
What changed on the Mac app in 2026

Voice mode left the macOS app on January 15, 2026, according to 9to5Mac. Voice still works on the web, iOS, Android and the Windows app. If your routine depended on talking to ChatGPT on your Mac, plan around that change.

OpenAI's release notes list an October 20, 2026 entry called Introducing locked chats. It describes hiding chats from regular chat history. The same notes say retention and model-improvement settings are unchanged. Hidden is not the same as deleted, so read the setting's own description before you rely on it. The sources do not confirm how it appears in the Mac app.
How to decide what to turn off

If you only want the sidebar clear, use Delete All Chats and accept what it does not remove. If you want sensitive chats kept out of history from now on, start each one with ⌘⇧N. If you want one chat gone, use the single-chat steps instead. If you need a firm answer about retention, read OpenAI's current data controls page, because the sources here are from 2024 and 2025 guides plus OpenAI's developer and release pages.
What to do next

Open Settings, go to Data Controls, and check for the switch. Then decide whether you need Delete All Chats or only a single-chat delete. If you want the single-chat route, read [how to delete a chat in ChatGPT on Mac](/how-to/delete-a-chat-in-chatgpt) next.
Check the current wording before you rely on it

This page is built from third-party guides, OpenAI's developer reference, and OpenAI's release and community pages. OpenAI's own help pages returned errors during research, so exact menu names may have moved. Before you rely on these steps for client, legal or health data, read OpenAI's current help text for your plan and confirm each step on your screen.

faq.question: Does turning off chat history delete my old chats?
faq.answer: Not by itself. Delete All Chats clears the sidebar and the running history in the app. iDownloadBlog says your conversations were uploaded to OpenAI's servers, so a cleared sidebar does not prove they are gone from OpenAI's side.

faq.question: Is there one switch to turn off chat history on the Mac app?
faq.answer: The sources do not confirm one. A 2024 guide describes a Chat history & training switch under Settings, then Data Controls. Newer Mac steps mention only Delete All Chats, so check the labels on your own screen first.

faq.question: How long does ChatGPT keep unsaved chats?
faq.answer: OS X Daily quoted an older OpenAI FAQ in April 2024. It said unsaved chats will be deleted from OpenAI's systems within 30 days. That quote is from 2024, and the current help pages could not be checked, so read OpenAI's data controls page before you rely on the number.

faq.question: What is the difference between Temporary Chat and turning off history?
faq.answer: The sources describe Temporary Chat as a new chat you start with ⌘⇧N. They do not describe it as a setting for your whole account. Use it for one conversation at a time, and do not assume it changes how your other chats behave.

faq.question: Does Quick Chat keep a history?
faq.answer: OpenAI's Commands reference lists Quick Chat as ⌘⌥N and marks it ChatGPT only. It does not say whether those chats appear in history. Test it with a harmless question before you use it for anything private.

faq.question: What are locked chats?
faq.answer: OpenAI's release notes list an entry dated October 20, 2026, called Introducing locked chats. It describes hiding chats from regular chat history. The same notes say retention and model-improvement settings are unchanged. The sources do not confirm how the option appears in the Mac app.

faq.question: Does voice mode work in the ChatGPT Mac app?
faq.answer: Not since January 15, 2026. 9to5Mac reported that voice was retired from the macOS app. Voice still works on the web, iOS, Android and the Windows app, so use one of those for spoken chats.

faq.question: Why did a deleted chat come back in Recents?
faq.answer: It may be the September 2026 bug reported in OpenAI's developer community. The thread was closed on September 26, 2026, without a confirmed fix. Try the workarounds in the troubleshooting list, and copy anything you need first.

faq.question: How many U.S. adults use chatbots like ChatGPT?
faq.answer: Pew Research's 2026 survey found that 44% of U.S. adults say they use a chatbot. That is up from 34% the year before. The survey covers chatbots in general, not ChatGPT alone.

faq.question: Does the Mac shortcut work when ChatGPT is not the front app?
faq.answer: OpenAI's Commands reference lists ⌘⇧N for ChatGPT only, so the shortcut needs the ChatGPT window in front. Click into the window first, then press the keys again.

steps.name: Open ChatGPT settings
steps.text: Click your name at the bottom left of the ChatGPT window, then choose Settings. You can also press ⌘, to open Settings from the keyboard.
steps.tip: If you do not see your name, widen the window or check that you are signed in to the right account.

steps.name: Open Data Controls
steps.text: In the Settings list, select Data Controls. Both the 2024 and 2025 guides send you to this screen for history settings.
steps.tip: Data Controls is where the history and training options appear in the guides, so start here before anything else.

steps.name: Look for Chat history & training
steps.text: If you see a switch named Chat history & training, turn it off. OS X Daily described this switch in April 2024. Newer Mac guides do not mention it, so it may not appear on your build.
steps.tip: If the switch is missing, skip to the Delete All Chats step and use Temporary Chat for new sensitive chats.

steps.name: Clear the sidebar with Delete All Chats
steps.text: Select Delete All Chats, then click Confirm in the pop-up. The sidebar should empty. This clears the running history in the app. It does not change what was already uploaded to OpenAI's servers.
steps.tip: iDownloadBlog says your conversations were uploaded to OpenAI's servers, so an empty sidebar is not a full wipe.

steps.name: Check the sidebar once the pop-up closes
steps.text: Look at the sidebar. If a chat you deleted still shows in Recents, the September 2026 bug may be the cause. Use the troubleshooting list below before you try anything drastic.
steps.tip: Note what you see before you retry, so you can describe the problem if you contact OpenAI support.

steps.name: Use Temporary Chat for sensitive chats
steps.text: For a chat you do not want kept in history, press ⌘⇧N to start a temporary chat. OpenAI lists this shortcut for ChatGPT only, so make sure the ChatGPT window is in front.
steps.tip: A 2024 developer thread offers Temporary Chat as the workaround when the history option is missing. On the web, the toggle sits in the model selector at the top left.

troubleshooting.problem: The Chat history & training switch is missing.
troubleshooting.fix: Use ⌘⇧N for a temporary chat on anything you want kept out of history, and Delete All Chats for the sidebar. A 2024 developer thread reports the same missing switch on the web, and its poster said the FAQ was later updated to match.

troubleshooting.problem: Deleted chats still show in Recents.
troubleshooting.fix: The bug thread opened September 8, 2026, and OpenAI closed it on September 26, 2026, without a confirmed fix. Signing out and clearing the cache did not help. Try the workarounds listed in the Recents section.

troubleshooting.problem: Error: Could not load this ChatGPT conversation.
troubleshooting.fix: The same thread lists this error and Failed to delete conversation. Reported workarounds are Quick Chat, deleting the parent project, or a full local data wipe. Use the wipe only as a last resort, after you copy anything you need.

troubleshooting.problem: The chats are gone from the sidebar, but ChatGPT still seems to know them.
troubleshooting.fix: iDownloadBlog says ChatGPT may still reference past chats. Clearing the sidebar changes what you see in the app. It does not reliably change what OpenAI holds.
OpenAI lists ⌘⇧N for ChatGPT only. Click into the ChatGPT window so it is in front, then press the keys again.
Click your name at the bottom left and choose Settings instead. The menu route in the first step works without the shortcut.
